Terms and Conditions

Scaling or Failing · Bangkok, Thailand · 7 and 8 December 2026 · Last updated 9 October 2026

1. About these terms

These terms are an agreement between you and [organiser legal entity], trading as Scaling or Failing, of [registered address]. They apply when you buy a ticket to, or attend, Scaling or Failing in Bangkok, Thailand on 7 and 8 December 2026. Buying a ticket means you accept them.

2. The event

Scaling or Failing is a two day, in person event for ecommerce operators, running live interviews, presentations and audience question sessions. Speakers, topics, timings and the running order are indicative and may change. We will email you about any material change, using the address on your registration.

3. Tickets

Tickets are sold through our registration platform and issued to a named individual. One ticket admits one person. We may ask for photo identification matching the name on the ticket before admitting you. Tickets are limited and sold on a first come basis, and your order is confirmed only once payment has cleared and we have sent you a confirmation email.

Tickets are not for resale. We may cancel, without refund, any ticket we reasonably believe has been resold or offered for resale.

4. Prices and payment

Prices are shown in US dollars and exclude any taxes, bank charges or currency conversion fees your own payment provider applies. Early bird pricing is time limited and may be withdrawn or increased at any time. The price you pay is the one displayed when your order is confirmed.

5. Refunds, transfers and name changes

Tickets are non-refundable. If you cannot attend, you may pass your ticket to someone else at no charge by sending us the new attendee's name and email at least 14 days before the event. We cannot guarantee a transfer requested inside 14 days, because badges and catering are confirmed in advance.

None of this affects any refund right you have by law that cannot be excluded.

6. If we change or cancel the event

We may change the venue, dates, format or programme where we reasonably need to. If we move the event, your ticket stays valid for the new dates and you may transfer it to another person instead. If we cancel outright and offer no replacement date, we will refund the ticket price you paid.

We are not responsible for travel, accommodation or visa costs you have already committed to, so please take out travel insurance.

7. Events outside our control

We are not liable for failing to run the event where the cause is outside our reasonable control, including government restriction, civil unrest, strike action, extreme weather, failure of utilities or transport, or a public health measure.

8. Travel, visas and your own arrangements

You are responsible for your own travel, accommodation and insurance, and for holding a valid passport and whatever visa or entry permission Thailand requires. Entry decisions rest with the Thai authorities and are outside our control. Being refused entry is not grounds for a refund.

9. Behaviour at the event

We want a room people can speak openly in. We may refuse entry to, or remove, anyone who behaves abusively, harasses another attendee, is intoxicated to the point of disruption, or ignores venue and safety instructions. No refund is due where we do.

10. Filming and photography

We film, record and photograph the event, including the audience, and we use that material to promote this and future events. By attending, you agree to appear in it. If you would rather not, tell us at registration and we will do what we reasonably can. You may not record sessions yourself without our written permission.

11. Confidentiality of what is shared

Speakers share live numbers, margins and creative that are not public. You agree not to publish, broadcast or repost session content, slides or figures outside the room without that speaker's permission.

12. No guarantee of results

Everything shared at the event is for information only. It is not financial, legal, tax or investment advice, and it is not a promise of results. Figures a speaker describes are their own experience, not a projection of what you will achieve. Your business decisions remain yours.

13. Our liability

We do not exclude our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for anything else that cannot be excluded by law. Subject to that, our total liability to you in connection with the event is limited to the ticket price you paid, and we are not liable for lost profit, lost revenue, lost opportunity or other indirect loss.

14. Governing law

These terms are governed by the law of [governing law and jurisdiction], whose courts have exclusive jurisdiction.

15. Contact

Email us at hello@scalingorfailing.com.

Privacy Policy

Scaling or Failing · Bangkok, Thailand · 7 and 8 December 2026 · Last updated 14 October 2026

1. Who we are

[organiser legal entity], trading as Scaling or Failing, of [registered address], decides how the personal data described here is used. You can reach us at hello@scalingorfailing.com.

2. What we collect

  • When you book. Your name, email, phone, company, job title and billing details, plus anything you choose to add such as dietary or accessibility needs.
  • When you contact us. Whatever you put in your message.
  • At the event. Your name and company on your badge, and photography and film of the room.
  • When you visit this page. See the next section.

3. What this page does

The event page asks you for nothing. The contact page has a form. What you type into it, together with the IP address you send it from, is emailed to us so that we can reply, and is not stored anywhere else. Both pages set cookies and contact a few other services:

  • Our website platform, Lightfunnels, sets a session cookie, two cart cookies, and an identifier called lfbid that lasts about a year and lets the platform recognise a returning browser.
  • Google Fonts serves the typefaces, so Google receives your IP address.
  • unpkg serves the smooth scrolling library, so unpkg receives your IP address.
  • Sentry receives a report if the page hits an error.

We run no advertising pixels, no analytics and no remarketing tags on this page.

4. Why we use it

  • To sell you a ticket and get you into the event, which we need in order to perform our contract with you.
  • To keep this website working and secure, which is our legitimate interest.
  • To tell you about this event and future ones, with your consent where consent is required. You can opt out at any time.
  • To meet our accounting and tax obligations, which is a legal duty.

5. Who we share it with

  • Our registration and ticketing platform, which processes your booking.
  • Stripe, our payment provider, which handles the checkout and your card details. We never see your full card number.
  • The venue and our catering and production suppliers, for names, access and dietary needs.
  • Partners and sponsors, only where you have agreed, for example by letting a sponsor scan your badge.
  • Our email and automation providers, which carry your contact form message to us.
  • Professional advisers and authorities, where we are required to.

We do not sell your personal data.

6. Where it goes

The event is in Thailand and some of our suppliers are in the United States, so your data will be transferred outside the UK and the EEA. Where it is, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.

7. How long we keep it

Booking and payment records for seven years, to satisfy accounting rules. Marketing contact details until you opt out. Event photography and film are kept as part of our archive.

8. Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of your data, to correct it, to delete it, to restrict or object to how we use it, or to receive it in a portable form, and you can withdraw consent at any time. Email hello@scalingorfailing.com. You can also complain to your local data protection regulator.

9. Marketing

Every marketing email has an unsubscribe link. Unsubscribing does not stop the messages we need to send you about a ticket you have already bought.

10. Children

This event is for business professionals and is not intended for anyone under 18.

11. Changes to this policy

If we change this policy we will update the date at the top of it.
